latest.title: Factories: what your shops sell against what each line makes
latest.summary: Supply › Production and each factory's page have a Sold / day column: what the shops a line supplies actually sell a day, next to what it makes and ships. When a line cannot keep up even round the clock, its status reads short: needs N more machines, and the tip says what that gives, for example 1 more machine makes 9,600 a day against 5,066 needed. Every short now says what is short: hours, the ingredient order, or production, each as its own chip, so a short order is no longer read as a short line. A factory with a line short of machines opens under Needs a change.
